reason: The plugin primarily enhances DSH WebUI file input by accepting pasted, dragged, or selected files and managing them as workspace attachments in conversations.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 提供粘贴、拖拽和选择文件或文件夹的输入增强，并将附件作为会话工作区文件显示在对话中。
summaries.en: Enhances DSH WebUI file input with clipboard paste, drag-and-drop, and file or folder selection while managing attachments in the session workspace.

capabilities: Accepts files and folders through clipboard paste, drag-and-drop, and file selection
Copies submitted attachments into session workspace temporary directories
Displays attachment references as collapsible file chips in conversation bubbles
Provides attachment usage statistics and session or workspace cleanup controls
